import shutil
from pathlib import Path
ACTIVE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/ci/artifacts')
ARCHIVED_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/ci/archive')

def _read_retention_policy(pipeline_name: str) -> str:
    policy_file_path = ARCHIVED_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY / pipeline_name / 'retention_policy.txt'
    if policy_file_path.is_file():
        return policy_file_path.read_text().strip()
    return ''

def archive_build_artifacts(pipeline_name: str, build_number: int) -> str:
    source_artifact_directory_path = ACTIVE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY / pipeline_name / str(build_number)
    destination_pipeline_directory_path = ARCHIVED_ARTIFACTS_ROOT_DIRECTORY / pipeline_name
    destination_pipeline_directory_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _read_retention_policy(pipeline_name)
    destination_artifact_directory_path = destination_pipeline_directory_path / str(build_number)
    moved_destination_path = shutil.move(str(source_artifact_directory_path), str(destination_artifact_directory_path))
    return str(moved_destination_path)
